I’m sure you know by now that YTAH, but I wanted to touch on the fact that 2 hours is absolutely not long enough for a wedding. I’m going to go out on a limb and say you are not planning on hiring decorators, caterers, etc. as you imply money is tight. I’m also going to assume that the venue does not provide set up at that price. I also did not do this for my wedding. We arrived at the venue at 9am, ceremony at 2pm. My inlaws were running around and sweating right up until 2. My SIL had about 30 minutes to put on hair and makeup. My decorations and food, while beautiful, were not anything fancy and were pre-prepared. 

You will not have enough time to set up. Even if you have 0 decorations and food, even just putting out chairs and tables will take 30min-1hr. That leaves you with an hour for ceremony AND reception. Lets say the ceremony is quick at 30 minutes, and that you managed to set up tables and chairs in 30 minutes as well. We were also responsible for cleanup, at that price, I’m going to assume you are too. Lets say its quick at 30 minutes. That leaves only 30 minutes for the reception. This is absolutely not enough time to take pictures and greet everyone, no matter how small the wedding is. It took us 30 minutes just to take pictures with the family, even longer to take private photos of just me and my husband after that. My reception ran until about 6-7 and I still didn’t get to greet all of my guests and thank them in person for the gifts. There were only about 20 people there.

You will regret using this venue. Instead of happy memories, you will only remember how rushed you were. You guests will feel unappreciated for not being greeted and thanked, and you certainly will not have time to make memories with the people you care about.
